text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A refreshing breeze blowing off of a pond… I wonder where it comes from exactly?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hm… Perhaps it's coming from that forest over there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's Zephyr! Excuse me, I wrote a fan letter for—oh, she left…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: How do I keep missing her every single day? All right, that's it… Today's gonna be different!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The higher the altitude, the cooler the breeze. And that's not all… It seems to carry air from a place of pure, untouched nature.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello, Daruma. Hello, Orangey. You're both as lively as ever. Oh, me? I'm here looking for the source of this breeze.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I feel as if I'm getting closer.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, this is scary… Zephyr, wait up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh. I found it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The refreshing breeze wasn't blowing off of a pond—it was riding along this valley stream.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Wheeze… Z-Zephyrrr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh. I thought I felt a soft breeze blowing from behind. That was you, then? Can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-I saw you running recently, and I instantly became a fan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: At first, I thought you were a bit of an airhead like me, but when you ran, you were like the wind—like shooom!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You were so awesome! And now I'm inspired to be more like you—even though I'm kinda slow and clumsy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: So, um, the reason I followed you is because… I want you to have this letter I wrote!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …And that's what happened.
choice_data_list: What did the fan letter say?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well… she actually forgot to put her letter in the envelope.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But the potpourri she did include, along with her wind, were enough to convey her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She even said that my wind was "awesome," and apparently, she's going to keep coming to support me in the future as well.
choice_data_list: Let's keep making your awesome breeze blow!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Voicing her determination, Yamanin Zephyr seems more awesome than usual.
